subject.title: fix(guarded-mkdir): allow in-root symlinked directory components

question: Must pinned writes accept contained symlinked parent directories consistently in both Python-helper and Node-fallback modes, or is a documented fallback-only exception acceptable?
rationale: The helper's O_NOFOLLOW walk is security-sensitive and appears intentional, so neither changing it nor establishing configuration-dependent semantics is safe without explicit threat-model ownership.

options.title: Require cross-mode parity
options.body: Keep the PR open until the Python fd-relative helper safely supports contained symlink parents and both implementations have equivalent tests and runtime proof.

options.title: Approve fallback-only semantics
options.body: Merge only after narrowing the stated behavior and documenting that auto or require helper modes continue rejecting symlinked parents.

options.title: Preserve universal rejection
options.body: Decline this approach if accepting symlinked parent components conflicts with the intended package security boundary.

recommendation.title: Require cross-mode parity
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until the Python fd-relative helper safely supports contained symlink parents and both implementations have equivalent tests and runtime proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository security policy and PR discussion make this person the strongest available owner for the helper threat-model decision.
